events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict in Iran continues to escalate, with potential for further military action. This could lead to increased volatility in oil markets and safe-haven assets. The US and its allies are considering further action against Iran.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The conflict in Iran has the potential to disrupt oil supplies, leading to higher prices. This could lead to increased demand for safe-haven assets such as gold. The US and its allies may also impose further sanctions on Iran, which could lead to increased tensions and volatility in the region.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for further escalation or de-escalation

events.exitStrategy: Exit if conflict de-escalates or if oil prices stabilize
